entrypoints.description: Storage-neutral typed reader is the semantic replay owner used by PostgreSQL, DuckDB and product-facing replay.
Membership projection requires an explicit model semantic judge. Standard reasoning runs first; material-definition conflict must escalate to deep reasoning before catalog materialization.
Application service turns a CAP-0003-selected assertion set into an auditable projection decision without turning model reasoning into source Evidence or canonical Reality.
Deterministic read-only projection turns one already-filtered point-in-time snapshot into entries, progression and Judgment storylines while keeping canonical truth separate from labelled hints.
Researcher entry composes direct membership and deterministic industry-scoped grounded-memory entailment at one shared cutoff; optional discovery enrichment may degrade without hiding direct truth.

Researcher workspace keeps historical conflict separate from current research-only analysis, exposes archive coverage explicitly and permits optional current/discovery enrichments to degrade with diagnostics.

extension_seams: Researcher-readable trajectory/table/graph views over an already-filtered typed snapshot.
New read-only CLI/API/UI projections that do not reimplement knowledge visibility.
Compose direct catalog membership with deterministic discoverability from already-grounded Reality/Judgment; keep entailment provenance visible and do not promote it into membership truth.

Let a model choose the catalog representation among CAP-0003-selected source assertions; persist the decision as audit provenance and escalate material-definition conflict to deep reasoning before materialization.
Add labelled researcher time/range/as-of hints that preserve source temporal precision and never overwrite canonical time.
Surface archive absence as research coverage state without converting absence into world-state unknown/false.

Compose historical controversy with a separately labelled current research-only MODEL/JUDGMENT overlay; the current research workspace may show it by default while historical replay never backdates it.
Optional researcher enrichments may degrade with explicit diagnostics; truth-bearing catalog, Evidence and typed-memory reads remain fail-closed.

guards.description: Membership regression proves conflicting source definitions automatically run standard then deep model reasoning before any catalog representation is chosen.
Deep reasoning that still cannot resolve a material conflict stops before membership materialization.
Researcher interpretation permits a useful as-of hint while preserving unknown onset in canonical Reality.
Orientation proves future-known membership and Outcome cannot cross the researcher knowledge cutoff.
Current open-state workspace includes today's research overlay by default while retaining an explicit historical-only mode.
Research workspace returns historical truth when optional discovery/model enrichments fail and labels archive absence as coverage rather than world state.
Real Samsung acceptance proves source known-time/Evidence survive through the model-audited membership projection and no-lookahead researcher path.

non_goals: Direct SQL as product replay semantics.
Creating source Fact/Judgment/Outcome truth in presentation code.
Treating a model membership semantic decision as source Evidence, CAP-0003 reconciliation or canonical Reality.
Allowing a model to invent a membership role, entity, industry, timing or Evidence identity absent from the selected source assertions.
Silently promoting deterministic hints or MODEL/JUDGMENT analysis into canonical Reality or historical market knowledge.
Presentation code deciding its own Reality/Judgment/Outcome knowledge-cutoff eligibility.
Treating archive absence as proof of unknown, false or controversy.
Applying the historical knowledge cutoff to current research-only state or presenting that state as contemporaneous market knowledge.
Rewriting an original Judgment because a later Outcome became visible.
purpose: Own storage-neutral reconstruction of what Reality, Judgment and Outcome were knowable at a historical cutoff plus calibrated researcher projections over that filtered memory. Direct membership remains grounded in CAP-0003 source assertions, while CAP-0005 may use an auditable large-model semantic decision to choose how an already-selected assertion set is represented in the membership catalog; material-definition conflict escalates to deep reasoning and unresolved conflict fails before write. The current research workspace may show separately labelled CAP-0006 analysis by default, archive absence is exposed as research coverage rather than a world-state claim, and optional researcher enrichments degrade without hiding already-grounded truth.
revisit_when: Only replace if no-lookahead, typed Reality/Judgment/Outcome semantics, direct-versus-entailed provenance, source temporal precision, model-decision auditability, archive-coverage/world-state separation, graceful optional enrichment and the historical-versus-current-research boundary all remain explicit.
title: Typed point-in-time industrial-memory replay
